summary: Held policy changes are where you expect them, and more group names follow your naming pattern.

new.title: Held changes on the Approvals page
new.text: A held policy change is now listed at the top of Reviews & controls > Approvals, with each setting change and the Approve button.

fixes.title: Clones follow your naming
fixes.text: A cloned group is named by your current group pattern, and Re-add definition suggests the name your pattern gives.

fixes.title: Administrative unit groups use their pattern
fixes.text: Once you change the administrative unit group pattern, permission groups granted inside an administrative unit are named by it. With the default, nothing changes.
